name: VR Link Player
summary:
VR Link Player plays video from a direct web link, on a big flat screen or all around you.

- Flat 2D on a cinema-sized screen in the video's own shape, or 180° and 360° video, mono or 3D (side-by-side, top/bottom). The right mode is picked from the video itself.
- Smooth on long, high-bitrate files: the video is kept on the headset as it downloads, so seeking  back is instant and a dropped connection doesn't stop what's already there.
- Pictures and playlists too, stepped through with A and B.
- Subtitles
